rationale: The morning spike to $21.43 was fully sold back into the lower third of the range (price 4.69% off the high, below the quoted 5-min VWAP), which leans bearish mechanically, but the decline has stalled with price holding above the $20.08 open and basing in a dead $20.42–20.47 channel on collapsing volume (1.3k–16k shares per 5-min bar vs. 197k during the move). With 5-min ATR compressed to $0.03, no news catalyst, and no retrieved comparable setups, the compression could resolve in either direction with roughly coin-flip odds, so there is no informational edge to justify paying the spread with 70 minutes left.
